bundle.question: Investigate the runtime panics around 14:03 on 2005-07-11. What failed and what happened around it?

facts.statement: Distinct midplanes with a panic in that minute
KERNPOW 'Power deactivated' events on midplane R05-M0 at 14:03:23, 10 s before the first panic
Earlier KERNPOW events on R05-M0 the same day at 01:50:28

unknowns: The logs do not state why R05-M0 was powered off or whether it was planned maintenance.
The logs show the panics followed the power-off by 10 seconds; they do not prove the power-off caused them.

engineer.headline: 148 rts panics on 3 midplanes, 10 s after R05-M0 was powered off
engineer.summary: At 14:03:23 midplane R05-M0 logged 16 'Power deactivated' events. From 14:03:33 to 14:03:39, 148 compute nodes on R01-M0, R05-M1 and R04-M0 logged 'rts panic! - stopping execution'. The same power-off pattern occurred on R05-M0 at 01:50 that day.

findings.claim: 148 nodes hit a fatal runtime panic within 6 seconds.
The panics span three midplanes, none of them R05-M0.
The panics may be a downstream effect of the R05-M0 power-off, for example a partition spanning those midplanes.

unknowns: Whether the affected nodes ran one job.
recommendedActions: Inspect the job and partition map for R01-M0, R04-M0 and R05-M1 at 14:03.
Check whether the 01:50 power-off was followed by similar panics.

team_lead.headline: Power-off on R05-M0 happened twice on July 11
team_lead.summary: R05-M0 was powered off at 01:50 and again at 14:03. The second event was followed by a burst of runtime panics on three other midplanes.

findings.claim: R05-M0 power deactivation recurred the same day.

unknowns: Owner of the R05 rack is not recorded in the logs.
recommendedActions: Have the hardware team review R05-M0 power events for July 11.

manager.headline: One power event stopped work on 148 nodes
manager.summary: Based on the logs, a single power-off was followed within seconds by 148 nodes stopping execution. The logs cannot show customer or cost impact.

findings.claim: Work stopped on 148 nodes across 3 midplanes within 6 seconds.

unknowns: Job loss, downtime duration and user impact are not in the logs.
recommendedActions: Prioritize a review of power handling on R05-M0.
